name: Anbernic RG505

models.name: RG505
models.notes: Single model; colours grey, turquoise, yellow

summary: Anbernic's 4.95-inch OLED Android handheld on the Unisoc T618, positioned for PSP-era content at native 960×544 pixel-to-pixel resolution. Running Android 12 (V1.22) with documented vendor upgrade path. No Linux custom firmware exists for this chip from the community projects tracked here. No third-party OS warning on the vendor page (unlike the RG405).

specs.cpu: Unisoc Tiger T618, 64-bit octa-core: 2× Cortex-A75 @2.0 GHz + 6× Cortex-A55 @2.0 GHz
specs.storage: 128 GB high-speed eMMC 5.1 HS400, TF up to 512 GB
specs.media: 4.95-inch OLED touch display, 960×544, PSP pixel-to-pixel, 2× rendering resolution support

variants.storage: 128 GB eMMC 5.1 HS400, TF up to 512 GB
variants.notes: Single model available in grey, turquoise, and yellow. OLED panel sized for PSP pixel-to-pixel output. Battery life claimed 8 hours, ~2.5 h charge. Hall sticks, six-axis gyro, vibration motor, 3.5 mm jack. No one-way-door warning on vendor page.
